shot: RA-07 round 4 'Leg press out of order': one take, START to END, same locked camera
intent: A gym member in a navy t-shirt and grey shorts, a white towel folded over his left shoulder, walks toward a plate-loaded leg press. A yellow OUT OF ORDER sign hangs from a string looped over the top of the backrest. START: seen from behind and the side, mid-stride, head turned toward the sign, has not stopped. END: same camera, same feet, hips and back (he does not twist his body); he has stopped, glances back at the camera over his right shoulder with a tired look and his shoulders lift slightly in a small shrug. The machine, the sign, the plates, the dumbbell rack and the floor do not move.

hands.right: hanging at his side, empty, in START and END
hands.left: out of sight behind his body in START and END
